evidence.explanation: The Week 9 assessment asks four forestry matters: functions of the forestry department (793), the taungya system (794), a definition of forest and eight uses of the forest and its resources (798-799), and notes on forest regulation, 'selective exploration', afforestation and reforestation (801). open_items.detail: Week 9's assessment contains items that no 1st Term block teaches and one misdirected reading. (1) WK 9B Q2 (block 854) asks for 'compost'; 'compost' occurs nowhere else in the document and no block teaches manure making. (2) WK 9B Q4 (block 857) asks how to prevent excessive evaporation; 'mulch' occurs only at block 414 (a Week 4 pest-control question) and block 857, never in teaching text. (3) The WK 9B reading assignment (block 851) directs the learner to 'Pasture and forage crops ... pages 179-182', which is not this week's topic; the WK 9A reading (block 789) correctly cites the environmental-factors chapter, pages 212-216. (4) Block 731 lists pressure among the climate factors, but no block in Week 9 or elsewhere teaches it. (5) WK 9B Q1 (block 853) repeats WK 9A Q5 (blocks 795-796) almost verbatim. (6) Retained wording defects: block 723 runs 'CROPAND' together; block 750 has 'coaster' for coastal; block 779 has 'forms the re-growth of disease pathogen'; block 796 prints 'Soil pHB. Soil texture'; block 853 prints 'C. soil organic'; block 855 prints 'PulpB. timber'; block 801 prints 'Selective exploration', which is not the standard term (selective exploitation). No source byte is corrected here.
